result: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) is characterized as a cellular learning rule.
status_reasoning: Claim C1 reflects well-established knowledge in neuroscience. STDP has been extensively documented in the literature as a Hebbian learning mechanism where synaptic strength changes depend on the relative timing of pre- and postsynaptic action potentials. This is a foundational concept in the field and does not require additional evidence in this context.
